name: slack-status
title: Slack Status
description: Set or clear your Slack status from Raycast with presets, custom emoji, text, and an expiration timer.
author: sujha

commands.name: set-status
commands.title: Set Slack Status
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Choose a preset, set a custom status, or clear your current Slack status.

commands.name: clear-status
commands.title: Clear Slack Status
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Clear your current Slack status immediately.

commands.name: set-profile-photo-main
commands.title: Set Profile Picture: Main
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack profile picture to a random image from the Main set, and keep it as the steady-state photo until Fun is set instead.

commands.name: set-profile-photo-fun
commands.title: Set Profile Picture: Fun
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack profile picture to a random image from the Fun set, and keep it as the steady-state photo until Main is set instead.

commands.name: status-afk
commands.title: Set Status: Away from Keyboard
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to Away from Keyboard (:tea:) for 15 minutes.

commands.name: status-lunch
commands.title: Set Status: Lunch
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to Lunch (:hamburger:) for 45 minutes.

commands.name: status-ooo
commands.title: Set Status: Out of Office
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to Out of Office (:palm_tree:) for 1 day.

commands.name: status-sick
commands.title: Set Status: Out Sick
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to Out Sick (:face_with_thermometer:) for 1 day.

commands.name: status-pto
commands.title: Set Status: On PTO Today
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to On PTO Today (:red_circle:) for 1 day.

commands.name: status-vacation
commands.title: Set Status: On Vacation
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to On Vacation (:airplane:) with no expiration.

commands.name: status-oncall
commands.title: Set Status: On Call
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Set your Slack status to On Call (:telephone_receiver:); auto-clears at 8:30 PM IST.

commands.name: restore-photo
commands.title: Restore Profile Photo After Status Expiry
commands.subtitle: Slack
commands.description: Background check that restores your day-of-week profile photo after a Lunch, PTO, Sick, or On Call status expires.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Slack User Token
preferences.description: A Slack user OAuth token (xoxp-…) with users.profile:write and users.profile:read scopes.

preferences.name: presetsJSON
preferences.title: Presets (JSON)
preferences.description: Optional JSON array overriding the built-in presets. Each item: { "emoji": ":coffee:", "text": "Coffee Break", "minutes": 15 }. Leave empty to use defaults.

preferences.name: syncProfilePhoto
preferences.title: Profile Photo
preferences.label: Sync profile photo with status
preferences.description: When on, setting a Lunch status switches your Slack photo to a random lunch photo, and any other status (or clearing) restores the day-of-week photo.

scripts.build: esbuild src/set-status.tsx src/clear-status.tsx src/set-profile-photo-main.tsx src/set-profile-photo-fun.tsx src/status-afk.tsx src/status-lunch.tsx src/status-ooo.tsx src/status-sick.tsx src/status-pto.tsx src/status-vacation.tsx src/status-oncall.tsx src/restore-photo.tsx --outdir=. --bundle --format=cjs --platform=node --target=es2022 --jsx=automatic --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react/jsx-dev-runtime --external:react-dom --external:@raycast/api
